ctx.x: Yes, Joe Loss was a bandleader in England who recorded for HMV. And he had a band that was quite famous and we could get — somehow or other that recording was available. Eventually I even got perhaps the most original recording which was the Edgar Hayes recording because that had Joe Garland in it, and Joe Garland wrote the tune.
